description: This file implements prompt injection detection logic for a language modeling interface, including mechanisms for checking user inputs against prompt injection heuristics, integrating with language model APIs for moderation, and handling pre-call and moderation hooks. It defines the class _OPTIONAL_PromptInjectionDetection with methods for updating environment, generating keywords, checking input similarity, and async hooks for pre-call and moderation.

classes.name: _OPTIONAL_PromptInjectionDetection
classes.description: A class that provides prompt injection detection functionalities, including heuristics checks, environment updates, and hooks for pre-processing and moderation of prompt inputs.

methods.name: update_environment(self, router: Optional[Router] = None)
methods.description: Sets the LLM router environment and validates the API name if checking is enabled.

methods.name: List[str] generate_injection_keywords(self)
methods.description: Generates a list of prompt injection keywords based on combinations of verbs, adjectives, and prepositions.

methods.name: bool check_user_input_similarity( self, user_input: str, similarity_threshold: float = DEFAULT_PROMPT_INJECTION_SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD, )
methods.description: Checks if a user input is similar to known prompt injection phrases using a similarity threshold.

methods.name: async_pre_call_hook( self, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, cache: DualCache, data: dict, call_type: str, )
methods.description: Performs checks before an API call to detect prompt injection attacks based on heuristics and vector similarity.

methods.name: Optional[bool] async_moderation_hook( self, data: dict, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, call_type: Literal[ "acompletion", "completion", "embeddings", "image_generation", "moderation", "audio_transcription", ], )
methods.description: Uses an LLM API to perform moderation checks on prompts to detect prompt injection attempts.

methods.name: print_verbose(self, print_statement, level: Literal["INFO", "DEBUG"] = "DEBUG")
methods.description: Logs verbose messages depending on the level and verbose settings.
